## REQ-TOP-001

**Topic structure**

Every topic below the namespace Oi4v2 has the structure "Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/&lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Filter>]]". Each element forms exactly one topic level, except Filter, which may consist of several levels depending on the Resource. The topic matches the rule topic of topic/topic.abnf.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7, SF-035
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7-ddf5f8f2

> All applications, working according to the OEC Messaging Guideline, use the following schema
> — MG 7

> Each element in angle brackets forms exactly one topic level
> — MG 7

Notes: Graded by REQ-CMP-004 (mandatory at all levels). The ABNF is the formal form of MG 7 – MG 7.7 and the PO decisions SF-040 … SF-042 (C-018); topic/topic-patterns.json contains the regular expressions derived from it.

## REQ-TOP-002

**Topics with namespace Oi4v2 conform to the guideline**

Every message published on a topic starting with the namespace element Oi4v2 conforms to this guideline (topic and payload).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.1
- Verification: d7-validate, d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.1-37801eed

> All topics starting with the Namespace element shall be OI4 Alliance-conform.
> — MG 7.1

## REQ-TOP-003

**Other MQTT traffic does not use the namespace**

MQTT traffic that does not conform to this guideline does not use topics starting with the namespace elements Oi4v2 (or Oi4 for version 1).

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.1
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.1-c51ac67c

> Any other MQTT traffic shall not use this Namespace.
> — MG 7.1

## REQ-TOP-004

**Versions are not mixed**

An application that supports several namespace versions publishes and subscribes the messages of each version separately under the related namespace element and does not mix them: a request received under Oi4 is answered under Oi4, a request received under Oi4v2 is answered under Oi4v2.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component supports several namespace versions.
- Refs: MG 7.1
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.1-1d42af54, MG-7.1-a9c4c6ad, MG-7.1-d026309b

> In this case, it shall publish and subscribe the messages of each supported version separately under the related Namespace element.
> — MG 7.1

> Messages of different versions shall not be mixed, i.e. a request received under Oi4 is answered under Oi4 and a request received under Oi4v2 is answered under Oi4v2.
> — MG 7.1

## REQ-TOP-005

**ServiceType is one of the defined values**

The ServiceType element is one of Registry, OTConnector, Utility, Persistence, Aggregation, OOCConnector and ITConnector; a component uses one ServiceType for all its topics.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.2, SF-042
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.2-709618ad, MG-7.2-75c0743e, MG-7.2-dcabe6af

> Each application that publishes or subscribes data represents a specific type of service.
> — MG 7.2

> The ServiceType must be one of the following values.
> — MG 7.2

> Other values must not be used; a new ServiceType requires a new version of this guideline.
> — MG 7.2

Notes: Closed set per PO decision SF-042 (a) (C-018), stated in the guideline since C-020.

## REQ-TOP-006

**ServiceType of the destination or the publisher**

For the methods Get, Set, Del and Call, the topic carries the ServiceType of the destination that has to react; for the method Pub, the ServiceType of the publisher of the data.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher, requester
- Refs: MG 7.2
- Verification: d7-monitor, d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.2-8106cf43, MG-7.2-c2d6be07

> For the methods Get, Set, and Del, the ServiceType of the destination that has to react to these methods must be chosen.
> — MG 7.2

> For the Pub method, the ServiceType of the publisher of the data itself must be chosen.
> — MG 7.2

Notes: Call follows from MG 7.4 (the AppId of a Call is the Responder).

## REQ-TOP-007

**Directly connected device uses OTConnector**

A device that communicates directly with the Message Bus uses the ServiceType OTConnector.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: device
- Condition: The device has its own MQTT client connected to the Message Bus.
- Refs: MG 7.2, SF-035, SF-042
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: deprecated

Notes: Withdrawn by the PO (C-020, 2026-10-17): the guideline defines no such rule for the other ServiceTypes, so the sentence is not a requirement. The sentence was removed from MG 7.2 (SF-042 (d), guideline a992f9a). A device chooses its ServiceType like any other component (REQ-TOP-005, REQ-TOP-008). The id is not reused.

## REQ-TOP-012

**Resources and services are a closed set**

Below the namespace element, the Resource element is one of the resources of MG 7.5.1 (MAM, Health, Config, Data, Metadata, Event, Profile, PublicationList, SubscriptionList, ReferenceDesignation) or one of the services of MG 7.5.2 (NewDataSetWriterId); no other resource or service name (e.g. vendor-specific) is used.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.5, MG 7.5.1, MG 7.5.2
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.5-00e295d8, MG-7.5-49f4e58a

> The set of resources and services is closed: below the Namespace element (7.1 Namespace Element), only the resources listed in 7.5.1 Resources and the services listed in 7.5.2 Common Services must be used.
> — MG 7.5

> Any other resource or service name (e.g. a vendor-specific resource or Action) is not Open Industry 4.0 Alliance-conform and must not be used below the Namespace element.
> — MG 7.5

## REQ-TOP-013

**Allowed forms per Method and Resource**

A topic uses only the combinations of Method and Resource marked as allowed in matrix/method-resource.yaml, with Source and Filter present, optional or absent as listed there (e.g. Event only with Pub and always with Source and Filter; MAM, Health, Profile and ReferenceDesignation never with Filter; Call and Reply never with Filter). A topic in any other form is invalid.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7, MG 7.4, MG 7.5.1, MG 7.7, MG 9, MG 9.1, MG 9.1.5, MG 9.2.1, SF-041
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7-3d90df46, MG-7-db7ddd80, MG-7.4-0f22d9e7, MG-7.5.1-0315a6f9, MG-7.5.1-07b3b10a, MG-7.5.1-3d9669bd, MG-7.5.1-a89bdae7, MG-7.5.1-ca8822ce

> A topic must have one of the forms, which are described for the combination of Method and Resource in 9.1 Resources and for the combination of Method and common service in 9.2 Common Services.
> — MG 7

> These forms define, for which combinations a Source and a Filter are required, optional or not allowed.
> — MG 7

> A Filter must not be used with Call and Reply.
> — MG 7.4

> Depending on the Resource, some submodels can only be published, others can also be requested or even written or deleted.
> — MG 7.5.1

> The following resources do not make use of Filter: MAM, Health, Profile and ReferenceDesignation.
> — MG 7.7

Notes: PO decision SF-041 (a)–(c) (C-018), stated in the guideline since C-021 (MG 7, MG 7.4, MG 9, MG 9.1.5, MG 9.2.1); the matrix rows name the grammar rule of each combination.

## REQ-TOP-014

**Set causes an Event Status**

Every Set causes an Event with the event category Status and the event level Good, Uncertain or Bad – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The entity offers the method Set.
- Refs: MG 7.4, MG 1.3
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.4-92f7945e, MG-7.4-bd6a1c58

> From compliance Level 2 on, a Set must cause an Event with the &lt;EventCategory> Status and the &lt;EventLevel> Good, Uncertain or Bad.
> — MG 7.4

> At Level 1, a Set should cause such an Event (1.3 Compliance Domains and Levels).
> — MG 7.4

Notes: Support of the resource Event with category Status is REQ-CMP-023; the event content belongs to RES-EVENT/BUS.

## REQ-TOP-016

**Reply topic corresponds to the Call topic**

The Reply topic equals the Call topic except for the Method element (same ServiceType, AppId, Service and optional Source) and is given as ResponseAddress in the ua-action-request.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester, responder
- Refs: MG 7.4, SF-041
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.4-51e4221d, MG-7.4-d2add756

> The Reply topic must correspond to the Call topic (same &lt;ServiceType>, &lt;AppId>, &lt;Service> and &lt;Source>) and must be given as ResponseAddress in the ua-action-request.
> — MG 7.4

> It equals the Call topic with the Method Reply: Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Reply/&lt;Service>[/&lt;Source>].
> — MG 7.4

Notes: Source of Call/Reply is optional (PO decision SF-041 (c), C-018; MG 7.4 and MG 9.2.1 since C-021).

## REQ-TOP-017

**Health is published at start, on change and every 60 seconds**

Health is published once when the application is initialized, whenever the value of Health changes, and every 60 seconds as heartbeat.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device

## REQ-TOP-018

**Source is the encoded Identification Link of the described asset**

The Source element is the encoded Identification Link (REQ-IL-002) of the asset the information is about and forms exactly one topic level; for information about the application itself, Source equals AppId. In Call and Reply topics, the optional Source is the asset the Action refers to.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.6, MG 7.4, SF-041
- Verification: d7-validate, d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.4-8875bc60, MG-7.6-256439e8, MG-7.6-4eafb027

> The Source must always describe the asset providing the information.
> — MG 7.6

> The Source must always be exactly one topic level.
> — MG 7.6

> The optional &lt;Source> contains the Identification Link of the asset the Action refers to.
> — MG 7.4

## REQ-TOP-019

**Filter levels are Topic encoded Strings**

Every Filter level is a non-empty UTF-8 string without "+", "#", "/" and U+0000 (&lt;Topic encoded String>). These characters are written as "%2B", "%23" and "%2F" and "%" itself as "%25" (upper-case hex digits); no other character is encoded, so "%" occurs only in these four sequences.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.7, SF-040
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.7-0302ebd1, MG-7.7-14d47137, MG-7.7-4008d4db, MG-7.7-de11d585, MG-7.7-e91796a5

> The Filter shall not include characters, which are used as special characters in MQTT topics.
> — MG 7.7

> If one of those characters shall be used within a level, it shall be percent-encoded according to RFC 3986, 2.1 (+ as %2B,
> — MG 7.7

> In this case, the character % itself shall be encoded as %25. No other characters are encoded.
> — MG 7.7

> The hexadecimal digits shall be written in upper case.
> — MG 7.7

> The character % must only occur in the four sequences %2B, %23, %2F and %25; any other use (e.g. %2b, %20 or a single %) makes the topic invalid.
> — MG 7.7

Notes: PO decision SF-040 (a)–(c) (C-018), stated in the guideline since C-020 (non-empty levels: REQ-TOP-021). The exclusion of U+0000 follows from MQTT (forbidden in topic names). Grammar rule filter-level.

## REQ-TOP-021

**Filter does not start or end with a slash**

The Filter does not start or end with "/" and has no empty level ("//"); "/" only separates the levels defined by the Resource.

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.7, SF-040
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.7-2447b66f

> The Filter must not start or end with a /, and a level of the Filter must not be empty (e.g. Data//Oee).
> — MG 7.7

Notes: Empty levels per PO decision SF-040 (c) (C-018), stated in the guideline since C-020.

## REQ-TOP-022

**Filter structure of Data, Metadata, Config and the lists**

The Filter of Data and Metadata is the Tag (name of the data set or metadata set), the Filter of Config is the Context.Name, each one level. The Filter of PublicationList and SubscriptionList is &lt;ResourceType>[/&lt;Tag>], where ResourceType is a resource of MG 7.5.1 and Tag is the complete Filter of that resource (Tag, Context.Name or &lt;EventCategory>/&lt;EventLevel>); &lt;ResourceType>/&lt;Tag> is only used for Data, Metadata, Config and Event, all other resources take &lt;ResourceType> only.

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: component
- Refs: MG 7.7, SF-035, SF-041
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.7-26d26349, MG-7.7-48c1f6cb, MG-7.7-50e7d38a, MG-7.7-785178ed, MG-7.7-ef133865, MG-7.7-ff249984

> Depending on the resource to filter for, the Filter can be &lt;ResourceType> or &lt;ResourceType>/&lt;Tag>.
> — MG 7.7

> &lt;Tag> is the complete Filter of this resource, as defined in the following sections
> — MG 7.7

> &lt;ResourceType>/&lt;Tag> filters are only used for the resources Data, Metadata, Config and Event.
> — MG 7.7

> For the resources Data and Metadata, the Filter contains the name of the desired data set or metadata set.
> — MG 7.7

Notes: PO decision SF-041 (d) (C-018), stated in MG 7.7 since C-021. Grammar rules list-filter, tag, context-name.

## REQ-TOP-023

**Filter structure of Event**

The Filter of Event is &lt;EventCategory>/&lt;EventLevel> with the categories Syslog (levels Debug, Informational, Notice, Warning, Error, Critical, Alert, Emergency), Status (levels Good, Uncertain, Bad – the class of the OPC UA status code: 0x00 Good, 0x40 Uncertain, 0x80 Bad) and Generic (any Topic encoded String as level).

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 7.7, SF-035, SF-042
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-7.7-1fb5a35b, MG-7.7-30c43fe2, MG-7.7-536626e7, MG-7.7-6b91a4d3, MG-7.7-9af39c8b, MG-7.7-d56fbf40, MG-7.7-e433a1da

> The LogLevel filter can be used to filter messages for a particular logging level.
> — MG 7.7

> For example, a status event with the status code 0x80060000 (BadEncodingError) is published with the Filter Status/Bad.
> — MG 7.7

> The &lt;EventCategory> describes the category and must be one of Syslog, Status or Generic; other categories must not be used.
> — MG 7.7

Notes: Closed category set and free GenericLevel per PO decision SF-042 (b), (c) (C-018), stated in the guideline since C-020. Grammar rule event-filter.

An application uses Syslog events of level Informational carefully (e.g. disabled by default).

- Keyword: SHOULD

- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device

## REQ-TOP-026

**Syslog levels are chosen by their meaning**

An application chooses the Syslog level by the meaning given in MG 7.7: Notice for normal but significant events from outside the system, Critical for unexpected states inside the system, Alert for serviceable internal errors; Emergency, Alert and Critical signal that the component must be exchanged or serviced, Error and Warning that a troubleshooting activity might be necessary, Notice and Informational normal but important events.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 7.7

Notes: "must be exchanged or serviced" and "must be indicated to the user" describe the meaning of the levels inside a note that "should be interpreted as follows"; they are no separate obligations of the publisher.

## REQ-TOP-027

**Log level is configurable**

The published Syslog levels are configurable (e.g. one PublicationList entry per level, Debug and Informational disabled by default).

- Keyword: SHOULD
